data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Alpheios, meaning 'giver of strength'. In Greek mythology, Alpheios was a river god, often depicted as an old man. The name Alverta is a feminine variant and carries the symbolism of resilience and enduring strength. The name Alverta carries the meaning “Old man's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alverta usually hope their child will grow to embody old man's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
